title: Signed Boolean recursion on all thirty ordered distinct S4 pairs

sources.role: six signed S4 inputs, unsigned block recursion, Boolean concatenation, cyclic four-bit flip, and Garden acceptance rule
exact signed CC, CT, CV, TT, TV, and VV comparison fixtures

conventions.Boolean word: bit zero controls matrix row one, following Eq. (2.21)
conventions.acceptance: exact bosonic and fermionic Garden closure with R_I = L_I transpose
conventions.cyclic flip: the eight four-adjacent-bit runs listed after Eq. (2.23)
conventions.ordered pairs: all 6 x 5 ordered pairs with unequal S4 labels
conventions.selection: all closing masks are retained; first-closing order is recorded but not treated as invariant

hymn.interpretation: formal matrix product only; this candidate does not satisfy Garden closure
